svg.title: Marketing and research what-if preview
svg.desc: All figures are fictional and illustrative. With 10,000 people reached, marketing response rates of 2% and 1% give 200 and 100 responses, then 50 and 25 purchases at a fixed 25% purchase-conversion rate. Purchases are sales counts, not revenue or qualified leads. Research survey-start rates of 25% and 15% give 200 and 120 starts from 800 invitations, then 160 and 96 completed responses at a fixed 80% completion rate. Usability and later participant retention are not modeled. No likelihood, forecast or preferred scenario is implied.

g.text: 10,000 reached; 25% purchase conversion. Lead qualification not modeled.
800 invitations; 80% of starts complete the survey.
Usability and later retention are not modeled. No sample-adequacy claim.
Change assumptions. Keep evidence and uncertainty visible.
In development. Illustrative arithmetic, not a forecast.
